claims.statement: Email and SMS share one physical queue with a channel message-attribute filter; isolation is achieved by separate consumer deployables, not separate queues.
The queue envelope carries notification intent plus a channel tag and never a pre-rendered body; rendering happens in the worker at send time.
Delivery state is keyed per (intent_id, channel, attempt_no), so one shared message-set can succeed on email and dead-letter on SMS independently.
This design rests on six deferred design-level decisions recorded as assumptions A1-A6; no requirement.md exists, so its FR references are provisional.
